sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fete Element (increases all stats by 100%, increases cost recovery speed by 10, Ability Power is boosted by 30 when attacking an enemy in Break) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000

[Shield Hero Sword] Raphtalia or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
